name: Antalya Museum
scope: The original Antalya archaeology museum as it stood in June 2024, including the articulated galleries, attached two-storey additions, altered tiled roofs and enclosed lapidarium along the open southern exhibition gardens.

review.notes: Started with Qualla. Its cleared architectural photographs show other structures in Antalya. The two verified Commons CC0 originals show museum objects. Use the historical map, the city council’s written conservation survey and the architects’ written descriptions for the former museum.
